name: cited-answer
about: An answer (answer.md) to a question about your sources that quotes them — at least min_quotes quotations, each word for word — and uses only numbers found in them. Proves the evidence is real, not that it supports the answer.
instructions: Reply with the answer only. Support it with quotations from the sources, in double quotes or as > block quotes, copied word for word (at least four words each). Use only numbers that appear in the sources, written the same way.

sources.about: the source text(s) the answer must rest on

min_quotes.about: the fewest quotations the answer must contain
